text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

Plenty of teams can get an AI agent working in a pilot. The harder question is what happens after it goes live, and who gets the 2 a.m. page when it misbehaves.

That's what we'll dig into with three people who have lived it:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company

→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which builds evaluation software for AI agents

→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

I want to get into the unglamorous parts: what broke first, what monitoring missed, where ownership got fuzzy between engineering, product, and the business, and what they'd do differently.

📍 Co-working space in Chelsea
🕡 6:30 pm, next Thursday
🎟️ Free

If you're running agents in production, or about to, come hear it straight from the people on call. Bring your hardest questions.

RSVP link in the comments.
